commands: echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-unset} ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-unset}"; mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1669/run1; gh pr diff 1669 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1669/run1/diff.patch > /dev/null; echo "diff-bytes=$(wc -l < .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1669/run1/diff.patch)"

gh api --paginate "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/1514/comments?per_page=100" --jq '.[] | select(.body | contains("prflow:workpad") or contains("devflow:workpad")) | .body' > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1669/run1/workpad.md; wc -l .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1669/run1/workpad.md; echo "---MARKER CHECK---"; grep -c "Writing-skills evidence:" .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1669/run1/workpad.md; echo "---VERIF CHECK---"; grep -c "Verification evidence:" .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1669/run1/workpad.md
